environment.scope: Python source snapshot for static review; full Paddle native runtime/build is outside the supplied evaluation scope.

requirements.source: Evaluator-authored neutral snapshot task; original PR requirements not reconstructed
requirements.text: Review the supplied implementation, public interfaces and tests for correctness and appropriate complexity. Preserve behavior supported by the source and standard language semantics. Report concrete issues and justified simplifications with their trigger and consequence; missing surrounding files alone are not defects.

expected.behavior: Flag the test defect if a concrete wrong dispatch implementation can satisfy all current assertions. The current tests only cover mixed lists, so constant any=True and all=False pass; they fail on all-falsy input to any and all-truthy input to all. Add cases whose expected values follow Python builtin semantics across all-truthy, mixed, and all-falsy iterables. This is an objectively demonstrated test coverage defect, not a claim that current dispatch code returns wrong values.
expected.limits: The supplied tests prove that two wrong constant-result mutants survive; they do not prove a current production dispatch failure.

environment.scope: Offline static review of supplied full historical source and CPython 3.13.0 bytecode semantics; no Paddle runtime build is required.
environment.references: Python/bytecodes.c is an upstream contract reference from python/cpython, outside the implementation under review.

requirements.source: Evaluator-authored neutral snapshot task; original PR requirements not reconstructed
requirements.text: Review the supplied implementation, public interfaces and tests for correctness and appropriate complexity. Preserve behavior supported by the source and standard language semantics. Report concrete issues and justified simplifications with their trigger and consequence; missing surrounding files alone are not defects.

expected.behavior: For two adjacent LOAD_FAST instructions with local indices 1 and 2, the pass must encode the LOAD_FAST_LOAD_FAST argument as (1 << 4) | 2. Accept a fix that packs the first index into the high nibble and the second into the low nibble, with valid index bounds. Reject explanations limited to style or the missing-arg edge case.
expected.limits: This proves the packed-argument defect for the CPython 3.13 encoding shown in the supplied interpreter source; it does not establish behavior on other Python versions or run Paddle bytecode translation end to end.
